issues.detail: Welcome galley cabinet: no glass, interior too bright and neutral (overcorrected from w10)
issues.problem: With every pane element removed, the door reads as an open shelf unit: shelves and boxes in plain view, a 5 cm frame with nothing in it, and no tint, reflection or pane edge. In both real photos it is unmistakably a smoked-glass door. A mauve-grey tint dims the interior, a rounded-rectangle pane sits inside a thick dark frame with an inner reveal, and one soft vertical reflection runs on the glass.
issues.fix: 10_mono.js buildWelcomeGalley l.368-372. (1) Scale the interior back to about 0.75x and add a mauve tint. Back panel '#5a5450' e0.1 -> '#463c3e' e0.06. Shelves '#8a857d' -> '#6a6062'. Boxes x0.75 (e.g. '#938f88' -> '#6e6866'). Tray '#c9c6bf' -> '#a8a2a0'. (2) Add a glass cue that is not an opaque pane. Add an inner reveal: four gBox 0.012-wide, 0.025-deep strips in '#1c1a19' just inside the stiles/rails at o+0.07, so the pane reads as recessed. Add rounded inner corners by putting gRBox(0.34, 0.70, 0.004, 0.03, 1) as a thin outline: draw it once in welcomeChar at o+0.072, then the same size minus 0.01 in MONMAT.bevBlack, ONLY as a 4-piece frame and never a filled quad. (3) Replace the 6 mm hinge reflection (invisible at 930 px) with one soft 0.025 m strip gQuad(0.025, 0.66) at u = -0.12, o+0.088, { c: '#6e6468', r: 0.05, e: 0.02 }. If MAT has an alpha/glass material (check MAT.glass in 02_geo/04_shaders), use it at about 25 % opacity for a full gQuad(0.34, 0.70) tint plane instead; that is the correct answer if available. Target: pane mean about #4a4243, p90 about #6a6064.

issues.detail: Galley brewers: jug is a bottle-shaped carafe with sticker reflections; brew basket a thin bar
issues.problem: The lathe profile narrows to a neck (0.03k at 0.14), so the pot reads as a glass milk bottle or egg. The real ANA pots (sans_38, sansY_44) are squat polished-stainless vacuum pots with a wide black lid, filling about 85 % of the bay width, with streaky dark/bright vertical reflections and a big black loop handle at the side. The baked highlight (1 cm quad, #dcdad4) and dark band (#3a3630) are flat crisp rectangles, which read as printed '| ]' marks. Above the pot, the real maker has a substantial projecting brew basket (about 5 cm tall, 8 cm proud, grey) with a side arm. The render has a 12 mm steel bar.
issues.evidence: w11/m09_d4fwd.png brewers (500-655, 225-400): jugs egg-shaped, '| ]' marks at (520-525, 335-385) and (545-552, 345-380). sans_38.jpg (650-900, 90-320): squat pots, a grey basket drawer at y 165-200 projecting over the bay, and a black caution label at the bay foot. sansY_44.jpg (640-990, 60-250): pot highlight (900,170) #eee8ce, dark reflection (720,170) #393021.
issues.fix: 10_mono.js brewer() l.186-199. (a) Jug profile: gLathe([[0.001,0],[r*0.96,0.004],[r,0.03],[r*0.97,0.075],[r*0.82,0.105],[r*0.66,0.118],[0.001,0.12]], 14) with r = uW/2 - 0.012 (fills the bay). Lid: gCyl(r*0.68, r*0.66, 0.02, 14) bevBlack at y0+0.03. Spout: gBox(0.02, 0.012, 0.025) bevBlack at the front-left top. (b) Delete the two flat quads. Instead give MONMAT.jug { c: '#c8c6c0', r: 0.08, m: 0.85 } so the GGX highlight does the work. If a baked cue is still needed, build it as a thin lathe sector by passing a second gLathe of the same profile scaled 1.003 with only 2 of 14 segments in '#ece8dc' (bright) and 2 in '#3a3630' (dark), so it wraps the body instead of floating. (c) Brew basket: replace the l.190 bar with gRBox(uW*0.8, 0.045, 0.08, 0.01, 1) brewMetal at P(0, y0+0.095, 0.045), plus a side arm gBox(0.06, 0.012, 0.015) steel at P(uW*0.45, y0+0.1, 0.07). (d) Black caution label gQuad(uW*0.7, 0.02) bevBlack at the bay foot P(0, y0-0.095, 0.052) with one label line.

issues.detail: Bar: bottles opaque white, tumblers white cups, counter grey, fence-like grab rail
issues.problem: bottleClear #b4c2c5 with e 0.02 renders as an opaque light grey-white solid, and MONMAT.tumbler #dfe6e8 renders as white porcelain. In the ANA render, the bottles are clear with dark see-through bodies, bright rims and white labels, and the glasses are dark clear rocks glasses with highlights. The counter renders mid grey with white veins, where the render's is near-black gloss. The grab rail stands on posts above the counter like a fence. In the render it is a low edge rail at the counter lip.
issues.fix: MONMAT.bottleClear -> { c: '#4c5254', r: 0.04, m: 0.6 } (a dark see-through body that picks up specular), and keep the white label and cap. MONMAT.tumbler -> { c: '#3e3c40', r: 0.03, m: 0.7 } plus a rim ring gCyl(0.036, 0.036, 0.004) '#c8ccd0' at the top. MONMAT.basalt: darken toward '#1a1a1c' and cut the vein layer gain (or l: none). Check the w10 rail: if the l.239 rail sits above the deck because of a y offset, put it at BAR.deck - 0.02 flush with the counter lip and remove any vertical posts above the counter.

issues.fix: 10_mono.js l.625-629: pw = dw * 0.68, upper frame height 0.42 (lower 0.36), frame bars 0.035 wide, MONMAT.plateWhite -> MONMAT.cockpitFrame, and add 4 tiny steel rivet cylinders per side. Add a hinge-side jamb gBox(0.09, 2.0, 0.045) cockpitFrame at P(-dw/2 - 0.02, 1.0, 0.0) (shrink dw by 0.06 so it fits). Add a kick panel gBox(dw, 0.14, 0.014) cockpitFrame at P(0, 0.13, 0.03) above the chevrons. MONMAT.cockpitDoor c '#3a3332' -> '#4a4243'.

issues.detail: F ink-cloud bulkhead: contrast half the photo's, green cast

issues.detail: Galley inserts and carts lack aluminium perimeter frames, cart grips and channel posts
issues.problem: Every real insert and compartment face in sans_38 / sansY_44 sits in a raised aluminium frame with rivets. The carts have a recessed alu grip handle at the top and are separated by riveted alu channel posts. The render's faces are frameless rounded slabs on white, so the galley reads cleaner and more plasticky than the real one.
issues.evidence: sans_38.jpg standard unit frames (160-450, 0-270) frame #8a8578 against face #a29d8c; cart grips (670-725, 650-690); posts (530-560, 745-765, y 560-900). w11/m12_rearGalley.png carts (620-760, 400-575) plain white; w11/m09 inserts frameless.
issues.fix: 10_mono.js buildGalley: per insert add four gBox(0.012, h, 0.008) / gBox(w, 0.012, 0.008) MONMAT.steelDark frame bars at o+0.045 around each face. Per cart add gRBox(0.12, 0.03, 0.01, 0.01, 1) MONMAT.steel grip at 0.12 below the top, and gBox(0.025, cartH, 0.03) MONMAT.steel posts between carts.
